FAQ

Common questions.

Does it send the emails for me?
No. Copy it into your own email so it comes from you and your customer recognizes it.
What are the rules for asking?
Each site sets its own. Google doesn't allow offering rewards for reviews or asking only happy customers, and Yelp asks businesses not to request reviews at all. Check the rules of any site you use.
Is what I enter stored?
No. What you enter is used to write your result and isn't kept afterward. The only things Workblox Business saves are your business profile and, if you use it, your Contacts list. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Review Request Email is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
